versions.subject: Detect Ghost-In-The-Logs (disabling/bypassing ETW)
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    EventID: 13
    TargetObject:
        - 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\NalDrv\ImagePath'
        - 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\PROCEXP152\ImagePath'
selection_2:
    Image|contains:
        - '*\procexp64.exe'
        - '*\procexp.exe'
        - '*\procmon64.exe'
        - '*\procmon.exe'
selection_3:
    Details|contains:
        - '*\WINDOWS\system32\Drivers\PROCEXP152.SYS'
condition: selection_1 and not selection_2 and not selection_3
versions.spl: EventID=13 TargetObject IN ("HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\NalDrv\\ImagePath", "HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\PROCEXP152\\ImagePath") NOT (Image IN ("*\\procexp64.exe*", "*\\procexp.exe*", "*\\procmon64.exe*", "*\\procmon.exe*")) NOT Details="*\\WINDOWS\\system32\\Drivers\\PROCEXP152.SYS*"
